**Finding: compliant** (Rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

Section 14, read with §§ 1.3, 1.4, 1.8, 13.2 and 15.1, sits at our **preferred** position:

- **§ 14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right. § 15.1 further bars sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training without consent.
- **§ 14.2** — Present assignment of Deliverables to Customer, plus personnel assignments and a further-assurance covenant.
- **§ 14.3** — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and embedded Vendor Technology is covered by the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence in § 13.2.
- **§ 14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback voluntary and Customer retains unrestricted use.

No redline proposed. Two minor points noted in the rationale only (not deviations): Deliverable ownership in § 14.2 is "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" (customary, and mitigated by §§ 10.1–10.2), and the § 13.2 licence grants contractor-support rights rather than an express sublicensing right.
